name: spreadsheets
title: Spreadsheets
description: 读取、创建和分析 Excel/CSV 表格。
input_contract: XLSX/XLS/CSV/TSV should use sandbox_read_file as the first evidence path; visual analysis is only for charts, layout, screenshots, formatting, or explicit visual targets.
output_contract: Generated or modified spreadsheets must be written and published from /mnt/data.
runtime_policy: Read structured workbook data first; use rendered visual evidence only for charts/layout/formatting; publish changed workbooks explicitly.
